title: centaurea filiformis subsp. ferulacea
intro: Centaurea filiformis subsp. ferulacea, commonly known as Knapweed or Scabiosa, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as arthritis and allergies. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea filiformis subsp. ferulacea include its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce inflammation, and act as a natural antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
